title: Member portal
description: Use the menu to find the services available at your gym.
offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to use the member portal.
failed: We couldn't load your portal. Please try again.
claimDescription: Use the invitation given to you by your gym. If you already have a password, enter your current password.
claimed: Your portal login is ready. Sign in to continue.
claimFailed: This invitation could not be accepted. Check your password or ask your gym for a new invitation.
claimEmailDescription: Use the invitation given to you by your gym. We will email a sign-in link to the invited address to confirm it.
claimEmailSent: Check your email. Open the sign-in link we sent to the invited address to finish setting up your portal login.
completeFailed: This sign-in link could not finish your portal access. It may have expired or already been used. Ask your gym for a new invitation.
chooseDescription: Your login belongs to more than one household. Choose the one to open; you can switch at any time from the top of the portal.
chooseFailed: We couldn’t open that household. Please try again.
